correctness.rationale: The source Fourier formula gives identical inner-boundary leakage in the two Wirtinger combinations. The \(j=\pm1\) pair is expanded explicitly and has maximal real contribution \(S(s-s^{-1})\lambda t^2+o(t^2)\); higher pairs are \(o(t^2)\) under \(m s^{-m}=O(t)\). The quotient derivative is \(1/(2a(0)^2)\), and the radial first-mode quotient is \(\kappa-c_{s,S}t^2+O(t^4)\), yielding exactly \(c_{s,S}(2(s-s^{-1})^2\lambda-1)t^2\). The outer boundary is separated from \(\kappa\) and the source's nonvanishing, positive-Jacobian, and degree argument persists.
